source_read: Farmhouse Inns pub menus: every /pubs/<county>/<pub>/menu page in https://www.farmhouseinns.co.uk/sitemap.xml (62) and the getmenus feed each page loads (https://www.farmhouseinns.co.uk/api/menus/getmenus/<venue id>); 62 feeds read on 2026-10-12, combined sha256 3fd8c9396b78e7ecf957ba82fa7fa150bc374b11559f078ff943de9c362ac727; robots.txt of www.farmhouseinns.co.uk disallows /sitecore/, /media/, /images/, /js/ and similar, not /pubs/ or /api/menus/ (the site had answered 403 on 2026-10-10; it answered 200 throughout this read)
not_verifiable: allergens (Smart Chef, robots.txt Disallow: /: link only); which pubs serve the dishes printed at fewer than all 62
notes: Independent check, by a different method: three pub menu pages (Kings Mill Farm, Nottinghamshire; Walnut Tree Farm, Hampshire; Hillfield Farm, West Midlands) rendered in headless Chromium as a visitor sees them, each of their five menus opened with the page's own switch (?type=breakfast, main menu, no-gluten containing menu, desserts, kids' menu); 462 (dish name, 'NNN kcal') pairs read from the page text. All 119 published items appear on those pages with the same calories (114 matched by the automatic pass, the other 5 found by hand: Cheesy Garlic Bread Sticks 411, Tomato Soup 336, Choc 'n' Cherry Bomb 1144 in Pudding, Please, Apple, Pear & Banana Puree 69 and the kids' Apple Crumble 177, which the simple reader had missed as first items on their pages). Internal check: each product (by the feed's own product id) prints one figure at every pub that lists it: 0 products differ between pubs; 8 printed at one pub only are left out. Fixed in the script: two products with one name (vegan and vegetarian Cauliflower Wings, Katsu Load-it-up Fries) had been labelled the wrong way round. Left out: 1,881 rows of carvery plates (27 adult, 2 kids) and buffet breakfasts whose own description says 'As each and every carvery plate is different, calorie information can be found at the carvery counter' (or the breakfast counter), and 132 rows with no calories printed.
